When Cloud enters, search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
As long as Cloud is equipped, if a triggered ability of Cloud or an Equipment attached to it triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
reviewCaveat: 2026-09-17: this card's own trigger-doubling static ("As long as Cloud is equipped, if a triggered ability of Cloud or an Equipment attached to it triggers, that ability triggers an additional time") is already fully covered by 2 real, recognizer-derived, oracle-text-anchored sink facts (`triggerDoubling-selfAndAttachedEquipment-structural.ts`'s self-half and equipment-attached-half `event:'triggeredAbility'` facts) — the current facts genuinely are as good as they can get right now. But that recognizer only models the DOUBLING'S OWN PRECONDITION ("this static cares about a triggered ability firing"), not the doubling EFFECT itself as a real produce/consume graph relation — there is no generic "this card has/grants a triggered ability" Fact category anywhere in this schema to anchor a source fact for "doubles triggered abilities" to. So this card's real Panharmonicon-style doubling effect is mechanically real (engine.ts's `triggerDoubling`/`shouldDoubleTrigger`, ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #13, closed 2026-09-12) and its precondition is fact-covered, but the doubling relation itself has no synergy-graph representation at all. Revisit once the Fact vocabulary grows a real "has/grants a triggered ability" category (or equivalent) that could carry a produce-side fact for this.
